name: Hitogata-tachi no Mori ~ Soror Carnation
source:
Ten years after Yuris and Liesz became models in the Forest of Dolls...

The harmony of two twins, Atelait and Patelait (Aty and Paty), belies their deep secret...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE066642.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
尤里斯和莉兹在娃娃森林成为模特十年后……

两个双胞胎阿特莱特和帕特莱特（阿蒂和帕蒂）的和谐相处，掩盖了他们深深的秘密……

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE066642.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
